messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.2.4.4

1.2.4.4. Assembly of machinery or related products In the case of machinery or a related product or parts of machinery or a related product designed to work together, the machinery or a related product shall be designed and constructed in such a way that the stop controls, including the emergency stop devices, can stop not only the machinery or related product itself but also all related equipment, if its continued operation may be dangerous.

response.text:
machinery or related product, or parts designed to work together | shall be designed and constructed so that stop controls can stop | the machinery or related product itself and all related equipment | if its continued operation may be dangerous | the stop controls, including the emergency stop devices, can stop not only the machinery or related product itself but also all related equipment, if its continued operation may be dangerous
machinery or related product, or parts designed to work together | is covered by | this assembly requirement | in the case of parts designed to work together | In the case of machinery or a related product or parts of machinery or a related product designed to work together
